_desc: Your core identity — referenced by the hero, SEO/JSON-LD, footer copyright, and anywhere else your name appears. Fill once, used everywhere.
_sources: Resume (header), GitHub profile (bio, location), LinkedIn (location), internship certificate (name).

_fields.fullName: Your name (hero H1, JSON-LD, copyright fallback).
_fields.alias: Online handle(s) woven into descriptions. Reference: 'ramxcodes / ramx'.
_fields.jobTitle: Professional title for SEO/JSON-LD. Example: 'Full Stack Web Developer'.
_fields.email: Public email — shown in the hero with click-to-copy and used for the email social icon.
_fields.location: Optional 'City, Country' — not rendered on the reference layout, kept for future use.
_fields.avatar.image: Path under /images/profile/. Reference uses a square pixel-art portrait.
_fields.avatar.alt: Alt text for the avatar image.
